headline: Kothari Petrochemicals receives NCLT order to convene shareholder and creditor meetings for merger scheme
hook: NCLT clears path for amalgamation meetings
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals announced that the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, has issued an order regarding its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The tribunal directed the company to hold meetings for its shareholders and unsecured creditors to consider the merger. This procedural step advances the corporate restructuring process initiated by the firm. Retail investors in the company should track the outcome of these upcoming meetings as the amalgamation moves through regulatory stages.
whats_next: Shareholder and creditor meetings convened under NCLT direction
why_it_matters: Merger progresses to shareholder and creditor approval stage
